title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono hold a press conference in Cannes | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono held a press conference in Cannes, France, on 16 May 1971.

Their films Fly and Apotheosis had premiered at La Quinzaine des Réalisateurs, an independent showcase running alongside the Cannes Film Festival, the previous day.

Both films were shown again on this day, after which Lennon and Ono gave informal interviews to various reporters.

Afterwards, a press conference was held in the sunshine, with Lennon wearing a white YOKO ONO t-shirt. Afterwards they watched Viva La Muerte, directed by Fernando Arrabal, and dined at Felix, a restaurant on the promenade in Cannes.
